entities.name: Aryl nitro reduction to aniline
observations: The input transformation converts an aromatic nitro group (Ar–NO2) to a primary aromatic amine (Ar–NH2); the chlorinated fused heteroaromatic framework is retained.
Matched ORD evidence reports stannous chloride reduction over approximately 8 hours with 95% yield.
Reported medium includes methanol/dichloromethane/water; sodium bicarbonate is present for neutralization or workup.

entities.name: SnCl2 reduction conditions
observations: Stannous chloride, represented with water, is the strongest directly supported reagent for this nitro-to-aniline conversion.
The matched record reports methanol/dichloromethane/water, approximately 8 hours, and 95% yield; sodium bicarbonate is likely a workup or neutralization reagent.

entities.name: Alternative nitro reduction reagents
observations: Plausible but not directly evidenced alternatives include H2/Pd-C, H2/Pt, Raney Ni, Fe/NH4Cl, Fe/HCl, Zn/NH4Cl, and LiAlH4.
